title: 【老闆急件】先備份並清空既有任務池，改為直接執行；全面重構派工底層
description: 老闆於 Telegram msg 1329 明確指示：第一步先對 storage/next_tasks.json 做可回復備份，之後清空既有任務；暫停把工作送進任務池，所有工作改為直接執行。接著第一個直接執行的工作是全面盤點並重構整個派工／認領／commit／殘留收斂底層，消除無人認領、無法 commit、任務池堵塞與舊機制殘留。這是 user-assigned P1 急件；須直接開工，不可只寫計畫或再拆成一般排隊單。依五步結案 gate：live 證據、根因層級、底層重構、回歸與下游回讀、制度化寫回；未全過只能標 contained。操作含清空任務池，務必先建立可驗證備份並保留回復路徑。完成後以 Telegram 回報短結論與可查證證據。
containment_evidence: Task-pool backup/direct-mode gate, destructive delete-restore-feed rehearsal, and the implemented Operations Core recovery/ownership/backend-identity slices are root_cause_fixed_and_verified. The umbrella remains contained solely because a real paired receipt from two distinct physical Macs has not been collected; the second Mac remains offline.
next_direct_step: When the second physical Mac is online, run prepare-host on both machines within the 15-minute window, verify-readiness v4, primary and standby against that exact pair/backend digest, then verify-pair v4. Until then do not fabricate a physical pair, claim the preserved control row, restore the legacy pool, or grant unattended destructive authority.
latest_checkpoint: Cross-host evidence now binds the credential-free SHA-256 of the exact Supabase RPC backend across host readiness v2, paired readiness v4, primary v3, standby v4, and final v4. Same-fence/different-backend and post-pair backend drift fail closed before the first remote read or authority acquire. Clean merged-HEAD suites passed 48 plus 41 tests; production read-only receipt backend-binding-clean-20260726-1158 exactly matches implementation aacc19590821f958bf0fc15b40e1e77e56ce98a1be4d1773a6233b16aefadd8c and publisher operations_core/8; no authority or provider mutation ran.
